description: This Java class 'ConnectionStatusMessageMapper' maps external messages to internal 'ModifyFeature' commands, extracting headers like 'creation-time' and 'ttd' to set feature properties related to connection status within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ConnectionStatusMessageMapper
classes.description: A mapper class that converts external messages into 'ModifyFeature' commands to update connection status features in Eclipse Ditto, based on message headers.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with mapping options such as 'thingId' and 'featureId' from the provided configuration.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage to a list of Adaptable commands, handling exceptions and logging errors.

methods.name: doMap
methods.description: Performs the core mapping logic, extracting headers, resolving placeholders, and creating feature modification commands based on 'ttd' and 'creation-time' headers.

methods.name: getModifyFeaturePropertyAdaptable
methods.description: Creates an Adaptable for updating the 'readyUntil' property of the connection status feature.

methods.name: getModifyFeatureAdaptable
methods.description: Creates an Adaptable for modifying the entire connection status feature with 'readySince' and 'readyUntil' properties.

methods.name: applyPlaceholderReplacement
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in templates with actual values using an ExpressionResolver.

methods.name: getExpressionResolver
methods.description: Creates an ExpressionResolver based on message headers.

methods.name: getMappingFailedException
methods.description: Builds a MessageMappingFailedException with a specific message and description.

methods.name: extractLongHeader
methods.description: Extracts and parses a long value from message headers, throwing an exception if invalid.
